message:
The other day, I was rummaging through our go-bags, checking to see if everything was in order. My grandkids were watching me with those curious eyes, half-excited, half-bored. When I pulled out the water bottles, one of them asked, "Why do we need these, Grandma?" I chuckled and explained how they keep us ready for anything, like a surprise adventure or an unexpected storm. 

They seemed to grasp the idea, but I could see their little minds racing towards thoughts of camping trips and treasure hunts instead of emergencies. It made me smile—preparation doesn’t have to feel heavy; it can be a part of our everyday adventures. Have you ever turned a serious task into a fun family moment?
